listings.body:

The interior has white vinyl seating with blue accents, including an U-shaped lounge seat, a double seated center console captain's chair, and two front fishing seats. I bought this at the beginning of the season and got it all legal and had it out a handful of times. I also had it professionally gone over and they changed the lower unit oil and inspected the hub and other things and came back a clean bill of health. I'm looking to sell this asap due to a broken leg and financial help! Due to the upcoming season I will be soon winterizing and keeping the cover on as leaves are starting to fall.
